### Advanced Temporal Talents

#### Future Shock (Su)

The time thief can force a target to suddenly age. She spends an aevum and makes a ranged touch attack as a standard action against any target she can see within 100 ft. + 10 ft./time thief level. If she hits the target, it advances one age category. The target gains the penalties to its Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution as normal, but does not gain bonuses to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma that it would from normal aging. The target must make a Fortitude save (DC 10 + 1/2 the time thief’s level + the time thief’s Charisma modifier) to avoid this effect and instead be staggered for one round per point of the time thief's Charisma bonus. If the target fails the save by more than 5 points it advances two age categories.

#### Temporal Buffer (Su)

The time thief creates a field of unstable probability around herself which impedes magic and psionic attacks. The time thief can spend two motes to add a +2d4 bonus to saves vs arcane, divine, psychic, or psionic attacks made against him. This increases to +3d4 at 16th level. The time thief can decide to add this bonus immediately after seeing the result of the original die roll.
